hypothesis: A homoskedastic scalar Elo distribution may understate uncertainty when pregame team support is sparse or when the learned rating path is sensitive to historical outcomes.

rating_path.cold_start_limitation: Bootstrap trajectory dispersion is zero before any differentiating evidence and is not treated as complete cold-start uncertainty.

evaluation.admission_rule: Prefer the unchanged reference unless a candidate improves normal margin NLL and interval score directionally in every report season without using report outcomes for fitting or selection. Bootstrap probability means must also avoid season-level Brier or log-loss regression. No effect-size threshold is invented in this bounded run.

pit_policy: All Elo members predict a complete season-type/week batch before any outcome from that batch updates state. Every calibration and variance parameter uses 2010-2022 only. The 2023-2025 outcomes are report-only exposed development evidence.

uncertainty_separation.data_support_and_total_residual_variance: Evaluated as one empirically conditioned predictive-variance surface.
uncertainty_separation.bootstrap_epistemic_and_global_aleatoric: Evaluated as a separate surface in margin-squared units.
uncertainty_separation.not_combined: The support-conditioned and bootstrap surfaces are not added together because their uncertainty overlap is not identified.
uncertainty_separation.directional_strength: Uncertainty changes variance or warnings only; it does not force a team-strength direction.
